facts.material: optical and electro-optical components (laser, mirrors, beam splitter, lenses, filters, detector) in a housing (assumed as in the excitation optics assembly)
facts.function: delivers laser light to the capillary detection window and collects emitted fluorescence for analysis
facts.form: sub-assembly, dedicated part of the analyzer
facts.end_use: ABI Prism 3100 Genetic Analyzer, a fluorescence-based capillary electrophoresis DNA analysis instrument

gri_path: GRI 1: the genetic analyzer is an electrical instrument for physical or chemical analysis using optical radiations of heading 9027 (9027.50.40)

Chapter 90 note 2(b): parts suitable for use solely or principally with a particular instrument are classified with that instrument's parts provision (9027.90), since the assembly as a whole is not a good of a specific other heading (note 2(a))
GRI 6: 9027.90 parts and accessories; of electrical instruments; other (not printed circuit assemblies); of instruments of subheading 9027.50; suffix .50 of articles of subheading 9027.50.40

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts of optical (non-electrical) instruments; the analyzer is an electrical instrument
chapter 90 note 2(a) would apply only if the assembly were a laser alone; the assembly is a multi-component optical sub-system dedicated to the analyzer
covers parts of electrophoresis instruments not incorporating an optical or other measuring device; the 3100 uses optical fluorescence detection

classification.rationale: The ABI Prism 3100 is an electrical fluorescence-based analysis instrument of 9027.50.40, and an optical assembly dedicated to it is a part classified under chapter 90 note 2(b) in 9027.90. NY G86134 (in force) classified the excitation optics assembly for this same analyzer in former 9027.90.5450, parts of articles of 9027.50.40. In the current tree that line is 9027.90.56.50.
